FINAL DEPLOYMENT SYNCHRONIZATION AUDIT

Using the LIVE Render service shown in the Render dashboard:

1. Record the current GitHub HEAD SHA.
2. Record the Render runtime SHA.
3. Call:
   - /health
   - /version
4. Verify all three SHAs match.
5. Verify the APK download URL serves the latest APK.
6. Verify ivxholding.com uses the same production backend.
7. Test owner login.
8. Test member registration and login for every role.
9. Produce one report containing:
   - GitHub SHA
   - Render runtime SHA
   - /health response
   - /version response
   - APK version
   - Production URLs
   - PASS/FAIL for synchronization.

Do not mark deployment complete until all components are synchronized with live evidence.
